name: Voteban
short: Public starter voting system to ban users with quorum requirement
description: Allows users to start public ban votes with reasons, requiring 1/3 server member participation for quorum. All voters except starter remain anonymous.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores data about votes, immunities, and cooldowns for the purpose of managing ban votes.
author: YourName
install_msg: Thanks for installing Voteban cog! Use `/voteban` to start a vote with a reason.
